name: burnzombies
description: Clear abandoned agent helpers and reclaim resources on your Mac.
long_description: Your existing agent harness diagnoses abandoned helpers; BurnZombies supplies live evidence, guarded graceful stops and verified impact. No launch wrapper or computer restart. Native macOS 14+ app and stdio server for Apple Silicon/Intel. Use the single-command installer for harness skills and quiet checkpoints. Ad-hoc signed, not notarized.

tools.name: burnzombies_status
tools.description: Read process-family counts, pressure and receipts.

tools.name: burnzombies_preview
tools.description: Preview agent-selected identities with ownership rationale.

tools.name: burnzombies_burn
tools.description: Request guarded SIGTERM for a fresh preview.

tools.name: burnzombies_checkpoint
tools.description: Quiet cached-signal lifecycle callback; never stops processes.
